name: Inui Fumika
source: Fumika is a tiny kouhai from Reiji’s club who has a hard time being noticed around school and is unable to reach high places. Reiji is very useful for her, pressing the buttons of vending machines for her and even becoming her pillow for naps on the roof top. She is skilled with the computer and usually uses it to communicate with other members, since she is very shy.
